programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: MICA paramedic Steve is forced to deploy a high-risk procedure to save a man whose heart is beating out of control. With his distressed family watching on, there are no guarantees the drastic treatment will work. Flight paramedic Ray fears the worst when a young woman crashes through her car’s rear window and smashes onto the road. It’s party time ahead of Leonard’s last shift with his great friend Nat but they will be confronted with one last challenge before an emotional goodbye.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Paramedics work around the clock, fighting to save lives. A terrifying home invasion shocks Mike and Eamon. Despite his own terrible injuries, the victim is desperately worried about his elderly mother. Taz and Amanda take care of a seriously ill little girl whose every day of survival is a miracle. Flight paramedic Ray struggles to understand a bizarre chain of events that began with a stranger knocking at the door in the middle of the night and ended in a house fire.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At the Royal Melbourne Hospital, trauma patients arrive around the clock for urgent care. Doctors Scott Taylor and Jonathan Papson fear for a pregnant woman injured in a high-speed traffic accident. Doctors Andrew Wallace and Jana Alexander urgently treat a jockey who was crushed under a horse. Doctor Jason Gabriel-Anyassor’s patient is in agony after crashing into a truck. Dr Martin Dutch and Nurse Sarah Thomas resort to translator apps to communicate with a scared young tourist hit by a car.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: It’s Manic Monday at the Royal Melbourne Hospital as trauma patients pour in. Dr George Plunkett and Nurse Sarah Thomas worry a motorbike rider could lose his leg. Doctor Glenn Harrison fears a tradie, crushed under 300 kilos of cement, has brain injuries. Drs Emma West and Mya Cubitt celebrate Dr Jana Alexander’s return from maternity leave with cake, then Dr Mya and Dr Jana diagnose a ‘healthy’ man with a ticking time bomb. Dr Emma investigates a pregnant woman’s chest and leg pains.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Lives hang in the balance at the Royal Melbourne Hospital. Dr Mark Putland and the Trauma team have minutes to save a truck driver’s severed leg. Drs Andrew Trezise and Emma West search for neck injuries on a cyclist who’s collided with a van. Then Nurse Eliza Burke notices a red flag. Drs Michael Conboy and Steve Pincus struggle to relocate a student’s jaw after he yawned. Dr Andrew Wallace and Nurse Chelsea Jones fear a champion horse rider might be paralysed after a hard fall.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: For 175 years, the Royal Melbourne Hospital has rescued people having their worst day. Doctor Scott Taylor fears a tradie has life-altering neck damage after a ladder fall. Nurse Susan Hartman keeps the man completely still, but soon his breathing fails. Doctor Jonathan Papson shares nicknames he’s earned at work, but it’s J-Paps medical skills that a power-boat racer needs after a spectacular high-speed crash. Nurse Practitioner Paul Casey needs help to reset a dislocated shoulder.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: It’s training day at the Royal Melbourne Hospital as Doctors Emma West and Jonathan Papson run new doctors through their paces with make-believe trauma patients. Playtime is soon over as Drs Jonathan and Emmanuel Karpathakis examine a cyclist with glass stuck in his neck. Any movement could be catastrophic. Dr Michelle Thornhill and Dr Martin Dutch struggle to get oxygen into a young mother having seizures. Dr Mya Cubitt uses her phone light to see where her young patient is bleeding from.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency department creates a puzzle for Dr Jonathan Papson: a teenage rugby player who received a hard tackle seems uninjured, so why is he struggling to breathe? Dr Terry Kane, who came to Australia on a whim, faces the worst trauma he’s dealt with. A motorcyclist has a broken pelvis and could bleed to death. Nurse Chelsea Jones also fears his forgetfulness might not be from painkillers but a brain bleed. Dr Steve Pinkus has shocking news for a heart patient.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At the Royal Melbourne Hospital’s emergency department, Doctors Jonathan Papson and Emma West’s friendly chat about peaches is quickly dropped as they treat a mechanic who could lose his crushed arm. Drs Michael Dunn and Mark Putland rally the team to save a truck driver who blacked out and smashed his semi-trailer into a tree. Dr Luke De La Rue’s decision not to ride his bike in the city is reinforced when treating a cyclist with a horrifically mangled ankle after being hit by a car.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr Andrew Trezise worries a young dirt bike rider has life-altering injuries after a crash. The rider rolled a truck only the week before. The phone doesn’t stop ringing for Nurse Gunnar Petersen as patients pour in. Dr Jonathan Papson examines a showjumper in agony with multiple breaks after being thrown off a horse. Dr Michael Dunne and Nurse Ebony-Lee Butterworth look for hidden injuries in a stoic tradie who has fallen 3 metres off a roof.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital, Doctor Jonathan Papson arrives fresh from a family emergency after his daughter’s car broke down with his staff card in it. Moments later, he discovers devastating news for an injured ute driver. Dr Tsung Chung cuts short his favourite meal - peanut butter and jam sandwiches - to help a woman in agony after a high-speed crash. Drs Andrew Wallace and Emma West fear a chef, who fell down an escalator, has brain injuries. Otto wins hearts and cuddles in the office.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Trauma patients arrive day and night to The Royal Melbourne Hospital. The moment Dr Jonathan Papson hears ‘motorbike’, he prepares for multiple injuries and a world of pain for his next patient. Later, he’s impressed with a mechanic’s pain tolerance after he was crushed under a ute when the jack gave way. Dr Andrew Wallace shows off his ‘fugly’ shoes and colourful socks before seeing his next patient who has a punctured lung and broken pelvis from a bicycle crash.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every eleven seconds a cry for help comes through to emergency services. Flight paramedic Steve heads to the country after a tractor topples over and crushes a farmer. Taz and new teammate Erika hope for the best and prepare for the worst as a much-loved grandma collapses at home. A woman having multiple seizures has Michaela and Simon on high alert. The mother of two’s life is in their hands as she can’t breathe for herself. Steve and Jade’s patient has severe pain, but what’s causing it?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Alarm bells ring for Michaela, as a super-fit dad suddenly has slurred speech. Father-daughter team Brett and Teagan finally work together. They’re shocked by the deep gash on a woman’s leg after tumbling downstairs. Eamon and Mike are teaming up again, helping an elderly asthmatic man who can’t stop coughing. Veterans Doddsy and Andrew’s day is upended as they race to a motorcyclist crash victim with extensive injuries. A six-month-old baby gives Leonard and Cullen a huge scare.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Cam is confronted with carnage after a motorcyclist crashes into parked cars in a suburban street. The treatment Cam needs to perform could go horribly wrong, but without it, the patient will stop breathing. New partners Jodie and Nathan rush to an overheated triathlete who collapses over the finish line. Steve and the flight crew hold a rural GP’s life in their hands. Tanie and Marlie suspect a stoic 96-year-old is downplaying her symptoms as they look for signs of a ‘silent heart attack’.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Nicola and Risky have a quick catch up before it’s straight back to work, treating a disoriented driver who’s had a seizure and crashed her car. Mike and Eamon get all the red flags while treating a mother who’s having a stroke. Simon and Michaela work in cramped conditions, extracting an unconscious young man who’s collapsed at work and is unresponsive. Jodie and Nathan need police help to stay safe while tending an upset patient who’s putting himself and others in danger.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: In Victoria, a cry for help comes to emergency services every eleven seconds. Newly-minted MICA paramedic Leonard needs all his skills to help a karate student make it back from the brink of a cardiac arrest. Taz and Erika’s fragile patient starts to come good, then deteriorates fast in the ambulance. Flight paramedic Steve and the team respond to a horrific crash, where a single mum has gone off a bridge and landed into a river. Cam races to a young man with mysterious abdominal pain.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Simon and Michaela mentor a new paramedic in high-demand hands-on revival skills after a young man takes a heroin overdose. Mike and Eamon worry a teen could have life-changing head injuries after a fall and seizure at school. Nicola and Risky check an older driver for spinal fractures after a crash leaves him in agony, and he feels every bump on the way to hospital. Steve and Jade deliver essential care for an incredible woman whose deteriorating health is on a knife edge.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: An elite team is ready to save people having their worst day. Alarm bells ring for Cam and Doddsy after a healthy man collapses having multiple seizures. Jade is impressed with Steve’s skills as they support a scared patient who’s struggling to breathe with suspected Covid. Leonard and Cullen attempt a trick-move to stop a woman’s heart from racing. Tanie and Marlie suspect a stressed-out fraud victim could be having a heart attack.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Flight Paramedic Steve worries a teen motorbike rider could lose his leg, after a high-speed crash. MICA Matt faces a grim scenario, as a dearly loved great grandfather’s lung collapses. Taz and Erica are on high alert, when a drug-affected woman wanders onto the street. Father and daughter team Brett and Teagan have a gut-wrenching situation as a mother can’t wake her seven-year-old child. Mike and Eamon rush to a man who collapses in a pizza restaurant before his meal arrives.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Steve and Jade carry a top range of painkillers, but their motorbike crash victim won’t take any. Traffic slows Simon and Michaela as they race to a heart attack survivor drifting in and out of consciousness. Single-responder Jodie’s chest-pain patient has an alarming medical history. Marlie and Tanie’s elderly patient is in agony from a fall and can’t explain what’s happened. Father-Daughter team Teagan and Brett are called to a potential heart attack, but their patient is only in his teens.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: MICA paramedics Nathan and Jodie patch up a dirtbike rider who’s fallen five metres and landed on his bum. A suburban shooting has Cam and Al battling to save a young man’s life. He’s in critical condition with an open chest wound. Risky and Nicola are super-impressed with a spritely but unsteady 92-year-old. A road accident has given a young driver some small cuts, and Mike and Eamon then check for deeper injuries. An elderly woman’s dizzy symptoms puzzle single-responder Andrew.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: The Royal Melbourne Emergency Department is non-stop 24/7. Dr Mark Putland examines what’s left of a limestone quarry worker’s arm after it was mangled in a machine. Dr Assiya Halid checks a man for broken and dislocated bones after he collided with a car on his way to a date. Dr Jonathan Papson works carefully to remove a screw from a man’s thumb after a home DIY mishap. Dr Luke de la Rue fears for an unborn baby after a 30-week pregnant mother was hit by a bus.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department is ready to help people on their worst days. Dr Emma West fears a motor-cross rider has life-changing injuries after coming off her bike. Time is critical as Dr Scott Taylor’s unresponsive patient deteriorates with a suspected brain bleed. Dr Tristan Harding must straighten a young farmer’s severely dislocated ankle before the blood supply cuts off. Dr Mya Cubitt treats a cheerful 103-year-old legend’s leg for a nasty infection.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At the Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr Michael Dunne and Dr Jonathan Papson urgently need answers for one of the sickest patients they’ve seen. The 47-year-old man can’t breathe with suspected pneumonia, but something else is going on. A woman in severe back pain after slipping on concrete at work can’t feel anything when Dr Ilya Kardailsky prods her side with a needle. Dr Michelle Thornhill examines a teenager in agony after he fell five metres onto his back while riding a dirt bike.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s ED, doctors Tinnie Chang and Caitlin Young fear a cyclist has potentially life-changing injuries. The man is in intense pain with protruding broken bones after he collided with a ute. Doctors Terry Kane and Bjorn Makein see warning signs when they examine a 30-year-old man with severe chest pain who has a history of collapsed lungs. Dr Emma West suspects a happy older man is hiding his injuries after a motorbike crash, but scans reveal the truth.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s ED, doctors Jonathan Papson and Emma West struggle to remove a glove that’s embedded in a construction worker’s mangled hand. Dr Tristan Harding and nurse Tanya Wallace carefully check the spine of a man in agony after he fell off a roof. Dr Assiya Halid examines the shocking injuries of a driver who smashed his lovingly restored car into a wall. Nurse Practitioner Paul Casey and Dr Jana Alexander delicately remove something painful from a woman’s ear.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, Dr Emma West is on high alert treating a woman’s life-threatening injuries from a car accident. Dr Sarah Whitelaw isn’t sure what she’ll find under the bandages on a man whose foot was slashed by a lawn mower blade. Dr Jonathan Papson prepares for the worst after a paraglider, who is also a nurse, fell 30 metres and landed on his head. Dr Tsung Chung guides Junior Dr Norah O’Sullivan as she checks on a man who’s vomiting blood.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as Paramedics respond to everyday people having their worst moments. A rider is bucked off her horse and is lying helpless in remote bushland. The only way out is a risky chopper rescue but there is nowhere to land. Ben and his new paramedic partner, Mim rush to a young Mum who’s smashed her elbow at a kid’s roller-skating party and Bill tries to save a teacher having a massive heart attack.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as Paramedics respond to emergencies of all kinds. Laura and Aaron prepare for double the complications as a mum with a high-risk pregnancy goes into labour. In a first for the show, cameras follow the patient into hospital not to save a life, but to welcome a new one. Nhi and Carlos fear the worst for a motorcyclist with life-threatening injuries after a horror crash. Sam and Chris race to a teen who’s had a seizure at home and whacked her head on the tiled floor.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: South Australia’s first responders spring into action when calls for help come in. Ben and Mim find a grandfather in agony with horrific burns after spilling a huge pot of boiling water over himself. Lisa’s first day back from maternity leave has her examining a tiny baby with a soaring heart rate and high temperature. Sam and Chris treat a teen’s gruesome injuries after he attempted to jump a spiked fence. Bill treats a retired nurse who’s in agony from tripping while bringing in the bins.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every few minutes a call for help comes through to South Australia’s paramedics. Aaron and Laura fear the worst as they rush to a teen victim of a frightening shark bite. Sam and Chris worry a woman’s next breath might be her last as she fights a chronic lung condition. Ben and Mim must tackle a footy player who’s dislocated his shoulder and super mums, Sally and Olivia race to a terrified one year old who’s crashed through a glass coffee table.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as paramedics rush to help people in crisis. A leaking oxygen bottle blows up in a man’s face, resulting in severe facial and airway burns. Nhi and Carlos fear he could stop breathing at any moment. A violent knife fight has Bill on high alert. Laura and Aaron work extra hard to win a young boy’s trust, after a family holiday ends in disaster. And a toddler struggles to breathe after a dangerous allergic reaction.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as paramedics help everyday people in crisis. Aaron and Laura rush to a heart-breaking emergency. A young mother with advanced cervical cancer has collapsed in front of her family and is bleeding heavily. A bizarre case for Lisa as she finds a hard-core chilli lover in excruciating pain. Bill races to help a brave Vietnam war veteran who is gasping for breath and Carlos and Nhi are on high alert for a man with sudden chest pains.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every minute a call for help arrives at the South Australian Ambulance Service from people in crisis. Ben and Mim prepare for the worst as they rush to a high-impact two car collision. Later, the pair are called to a patient in the last stages of labour. Newly qualified Ben has never delivered a baby and he’s hoping this will be his first. A dementia case hits home for Lisa who lost her beloved grandmother to the insidious disease.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A hero bystander uses CPR to bring a woman back from the dead but intensive care paramedic Bill needs to get the grandmother to hospital before she goes back into a fatal cardiac arrest. Alarm bells ring for Sally and Olivia as they examine a churchgoer who’s whacked her head on a pew. A logistical nightmare for Laura and Aaron as they try to find an injured mountain biker in a national park and Dan meets a feisty 89-year-old who’s determined to reach her milestone birthday.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every second counts as calls for help arrive at the South Australian Ambulance Service. Paramedics, Sally and Olivia fear the worst for a young motorcyclist in agonising pain after a terrifying accident. Bill knows time is critical as he races to a man who’s collapsed and is now unconscious and Laura and Aaron are impressed by the courage of a little boy who has suffered an horrific fractured leg after crashing off his pushbike.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Royal Melbourne Emergency’s Dr Mya and Nurse Ebony brace themselves as paramedics bring in a volatile man who’s been on a two-day drug bender, putting himself and staff at risk. Dr Jonathan’s patient has a shocking fracture after falling four metres from a ladder. Dr Luke examines a man who has collapsed at home and suffered deep facial bruising, but what caused the fall? Dr Emma calls in reinforcements to save a mum whose life hangs in the balance after a high-speed crash on a country road.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A grandfather of nine has a broken leg and massive blood loss after a motorbike accident, but his vital signs aren’t showing Dr Jana Alexander and Dr Jonathan Papson the danger he’s in. A teen jockey has been crushed under a horse, fracturing her pelvis. However, the potentially career-ending injury is not Dr Mya Cubitt’s biggest worry. Dr Scott Taylor uses a clever hack for removing jewellery from swollen fingers, which isn’t something he learned in medical school.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At Royal Melbourne Emergency, a young abattoir worker is in agony after amputating her fingers. Dr Bjorn Makein and Nurse Sarah Thomas must stop the bleeding if there’s any chance of saving the woman’s hand. Dr Emma West’s patient has major head injuries after falling down stairs on her way to a wedding. Dr Michelle Thornhill treats a cyclist who’s come off his bike while not wearing a helmet. Dr Thomas Razga puts a young mum with an earring mishap on laughing gas, with hilarious results.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A crane operator crushed under falling steel at work is rushed to Royal Melbourne Emergency. Dr Jonathan Papson calls in reinforcements as the young worker’s vital signs worsen. Dr Emma West treats a pregnant woman who is semi-conscious and behaving erratically. Dr Michelle Thornhill reassures a man who has impaled a drill bit through his hand. But how will she get it out? Dr Scott Taylor recommends an electric shock to reset a father-of-two’s dangerously fast heartbeat.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Two teenage mountain bike riders who crashed in separate accidents are airlifted together to Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department. One of the teens has an insulin pump for diabetes; Dr Jonathan Papson hopes the life-saving device hasn’t broken in the crash. Dr Scott Taylor treats a paramedic who is now a patient after she was bitten by deadly snake while jogging. Drs Michael Dunne and Jana Alexander treat a seriously injured grandmother who was thrown off a horse, then trampled.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Two teenage mountain bike riders who crashed in separate accidents are airlifted together to Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department. One of the teens has an insulin pump for diabetes; Dr Jonathan Papson hopes the life-saving device hasn’t broken in the crash. Dr Scott Taylor treats a paramedic who is now a patient after she was bitten by deadly snake while jogging. Drs Michael Dunne and Jana Alexander treat a seriously injured grandmother who was thrown off a horse, then trampled.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: In The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, a pregnant woman survives a car accident. Now, Dr Emma West must stop the terrified mum going into premature labour. Dr Sarah Whitelaw and the team battle to save a teen driver who’s rolled his car, is unresponsive, and has serious head injuries. Dr Scott Taylor fears a diabetic man might need an amputation. A trail bike rider has crashed face-first. Despite his injuries, he impresses Dr Michelle Thornhill with his resilience and wit.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: In Royal Melbourne Emergency, Drs Emma and Jonathan battle to save a father of two from bleeding to death after he’s thrown from a horse. Where’s he bleeding from? Dr Luke looks for the cause of a law student’s puzzling condition which has terrified her worried parents. Dr Michelle’s young patient is in agony from broken bones after a motorbike accident and doesn’t want his parents to know. Dr George has grave fears for a handy-man who’s fallen six metres onto concrete while helping a mate.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Heart stopping moments at The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department. Drs Michelle Thornhill and Martin Dutch have seconds to spare as a man struggles to breathe after multiple heart attacks. Dr Jonathan Papson fixes up an old friend suffering severe bee stings from his backyard hive. Everything changes in a moment as he races to attend a stabbing victim who has no pulse. Nurse Sarah searches for the baby’s heartbeat after a pregnant woman is injured in a car crash.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Every second counts at Royal Melbourne Emergency as injured people keep arriving. Dr Luke treats a tradie hit by a falling tree. Later, he rejects a patient’s offer to mend a broken leg with icy pole sticks! Dr Jonathan is concerned for a uni student who’s fallen six metres from the famous Hanging Rock. Dr Michelle treats a young motorcyclist with broken wrists who’s kept his bike a secret from his parents. Dr Martin helps a mum of two with a painful burn injury caused by boiling pasta.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Australia’s ambulance crews are there for everyday people having their worst days. Natalie and Leonard comfort a schoolboy who’s fallen metres out of a tree on his head. MICA paramedic Cam fights to save a much-loved dad in cardiac arrest. Matt and the flight crew race to a fellow paramedic who’s been bitten by a deadly brown snake, but reaching the isolated patient is almost impossible. Mike and Eamon support a young woman with a debilitating yet all-too-common condition.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Everyday thousands of calls come through to Victoria’s ambulance service from desperate people. Nat and Leonard head to a hotel roof-top pool, where a romantic escape in the city ends in disaster for a young mum. Eamon and Mike race to a traumatised child attacked by a dog. Steve and Emily grow increasingly worried about an elderly nun who could be having a stroke. Flight paramedic Matt dashes to the high country as an off-duty firefighter’s life hangs in the balance after a motorbike crash.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Two million calls for help are made in Victoria every year. In rugged bushland, a dad with his two kids on board has crashed one hundred metres down a ravine. Getting the injured driver out is a nightmare and the teetering wreck could crush the rescuers. Mike and Eamon fear the worst as they rush to a teenager who has plummeted through a skylight, and can Emily and Steve save an elderly man who is on the brink of a cardiac arrest?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A call is made every twelve seconds, from people across Victoria desperate for help. MICA Paramedic Cullen races to a young woman slipping into a potentially fatal diabetic coma. She’s so sick, any treatment Cullen gives could make things worse. A little girl’s terrifying seizure has Glenice on high alert. It’s the 8-year-old’s first attack and she’s unresponsive. Marlie and Tanie treat a skateboard rider who’s crashed at high speed without a helmet. Mike and Eamon reach a fun career milestone.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every twelve seconds across Victoria, a call for help is made to emergency services. Simon and Michaela perform a high-risk intervention on a brain tumour patient having seizures. Cullen races to a man trapped in a wrecked car after an horrific crash. Nat and Leonard help a ninety-one-year-old woman who fell hard while helping a neighbour. Alarm bells ring for Emily and Steve as a man with chest pain worsens dramatically. A young stabbing victim has Tanie and Marlie on high alert.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: On the frontline, paramedics work around the clock, fighting to save lives. Cullen faces every parent’s nightmare as a six-year-old child is hit by a car. Simon and Michaela battle to help a man whose pacemaker is misfiring, sending agonising shocks through his system. Tanie and Marlie fear for their safety as a patient suddenly turns violent. A food delivery rider comes close to disaster and an emergency airlift for a thrill-seeker motorcycle mum who’s catapulted off a cliff.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A 38-year-old man has suffered a massive attack while enjoying a day off with his wife in their spa. Cullen fears he could die before they get him to hospital. A teen footballer has collapsed after a bruising tackle and could have a serious head injury. Eamon and Mike’s charm offensive might not work with feisty 94-year-old Miffy. A man has collapsed in a supermarket and a language barrier makes Steve and Emily’s job even harder.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A 76-year-old motorbike rider suffers catastrophic injuries after a terrifying crash into trees. Veterans Al and Cam race to a lung cancer survivor gasping for air. Emily and Steve help an entertaining patient with mystery arm pain. Mike joins the ‘fun’ ambulance to help seriously ill children escape from their daily challenges. Glenice and Doddsy are called to a bizarre accident, and a heavily bleeding cyclist is enrolled in the Marlie school of safety.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Paramedics work around the clock fighting to save lives. A do-it-yourself loving handyman gets himself into trouble when he tumbles off a three-metre ladder. With no memory, the brave patient may have a brain bleed. Steve and Emily are ready for anything as an office worker is hot and dizzy, and down to his undies. Babysitting duties turn into a nightmare for a terrified grandmother. Eamon is unimpressed with Mike’s fashion sense, and a former grave digger laughs in the face of death.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Exclusive cameras capture the extraordinary work of emergency service heroes. Steve races to remote bushland where a huge tree has fallen and crushed a man’s leg. Cullen takes drastic action to save a patient whose body is shutting down. Cam and Al bend the rules to lift the spirits of a nine-year-old boy after a frightening asthma attack. Homesick Emily ‘adopts’ a Nanna for the day, when she and Steve help a much-loved grandmother and a terrified daughter watches her Mum fight for life.

programme.desc: GLORY 13: on December 21, 2013 at the Ariake Coliseum in Tokyo, Japan. The highlight of the event was a Glory Welterweight World Championship Tournament. Two tournament matches were held, with a third match as reserve. The winners of the two semi-final bouts proceeded to the finals for the championship main-event. The event also featured other non-tournament bouts, including the retirement match of the legendary Peter Aerts, against Rico Verhoeven, and Daniel Ghiță vs. Errol Zimmerman II.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 16 slams into Denver with the Welterweight World Title fight, the Heavyweight Contender Tournament, and the debut of USA Martial Arts sensation Pat Barry. Belgian striker Marc de Bonte will battle Armenia's technical machine Karapet Karapetyan for the vacant GLORY Welterweight World Title, guaranteeing a fast, explosive war. At the heaviest end of the GLORY ranks, the big-boys are set to battle it out for a higher ranked spot in the Heavyweight division, and a chance to fight for the Title later within the year. The lineup pits Errol "The Bonecrusher" Zimmerman versus "Bangin" Ben Edwards in a semi-final, and Sergei "The Paratrooper" Kharitonov vs. Anderson "Braddock" Silva in another semi-final. The tournament winner will have to win two fights in one night to claim the prize, and the right to fight for a bigger prize later in the year. Also at Heavyweight, in a tournament reserve match, MMA veteran Pat "HD" Barry returns to his original love of kickboxing, facing another GLORY debutant in the shape of Zack "The Black Warrior" Mwekassa.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: On the preliminary card, a 4-Man Featherweight Contender Tournament and other one-off bouts were featured.Mirko Cro Cop was first scheduled to face Pat Barry, and later Sergei Kharitonov on this card. However, on May 21, it was announced that Kharitonov had to withdraw from the fight due to injury. He was replaced by Jarrell Miller.Miguel Torres was scheduled to make his GLORY debut as a participant of the Featherweight tournament. However, on May 28, it was revealed he pulled out of the tournament for undisclosed reasons. He was replaced by Marcus Vinicius.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: "Last Man Standing" features a lineup of the world's top Middleweight talent: EIGHT men will fight to the finish in a ONE night tournament, with the tournament winner being crowned the GLORY Middleweight Champion of the World. Last Man Standing will also feature TWO World Title fights, including Daniel Ghita versus Rico Verhoeven for the vacant Heavyweight Title, and Marc de Bonte versus Joseph Valtellini as de Bonte defends his newly won Welterweight Title.

programme.desc: Framed for murder a private detective has 24 hours to carry out a blackmailer's demands to clear his name.

programme.title: The Hunt

programme.title: Night of The Undead
programme.desc: So-hee marries a perfect man. One day she suspects that he isn’t as he seems and hires a private detective.

programme.title: Go Back
programme.desc: Ji-won a motivated new police officer is strangely bothered after meeting O-sun a social worker. On a hot summer day a kidnapper sends a message saying ‘If you want to save the kidnapped child donate money to the welfare center.’ The incident becomes a national concern as the media report it. Somehow Ji-won doubts the link between the case and O-sun.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The "Parque Natural da Ria Formosa" is one of the largest lagoon conservation areas in Europe. Bordered by five natural islands. A mosaic of sandbanks, brackish and freshwater lagoons and salt marshes. In 2010, the "Ria Formosa" was chosen as one of the seven natural wonders of Portugal. It is a unique ecosystem: in the winter months, more than 20,000 birds gather here. In addition, the nature park has one of the largest seahorse populations internationally. More than half of all fish species in the Atlantic are said to spawn in the lagoon.

programme.title: Northern Woods
programme.desc: It is a musical film a a tributeto the Nordic forest: it shows its development from a primeval wood to a cultivated forest. Once populated by wild animals such as wolves, bears, eagles, deer and musk oxen, complex re-enactment-scenes shot by dollies and helicopters vividly depict the colonization of the forest by the Celts and Germans. But as time progressed, the northern forest has on numerous occasions fallen victim to environmental degradation and overexploitation. Several provisions were made to protect this wild beauty. The Helsinki resolution of 1993, which stipulated that the woods be used in a way and in a magnitude which guarantees their biological variety and productiveness and vitality, is but one measure put in place to secure the preservation of the natural gem. Time-lapse photography and breath-taking shots show our main protagonist – the woods – in its stunning glory. This beautiful wooded land, changes throughout the seasons. Our woodland is a world-renowned ecological jewel. It is famous, well-known and loved by tourists, forest economists, environmentalists, historians and intellectuals alike.

programme.title: Germany's Mystic Forest
programme.desc: 2.000 rivers and streams dig deep into the underground and transport their water into reservoirs or "Germany's Wild Amazon", the Wupper. These forests and rivers, together with heathlands and moors, are home to a diverse fauna. Martens, badgers, wild boars, hares, roe deer, and red deer, even black grouse and hazel deer find shelter in these parts. Wolves also have a dominant presence, not to mention those who live underground, such as lizards, bats, and snakes. Accompany us on a journey where we explore every corner of this rugged land. Climb underground into the Bergisches Land, through the vast hidden cave systems that sprawl far beneath the forests. There is also much to be discovered in the water, dive with us in crystal clear streams and rivers with their diverse flora and fauna.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is one of the wildest roads in Asia: the Trans Sulawesi Highway. The adventurous road leads through Indonesia's fourth-largest island and takes people to spectacular destinations. To beautiful beaches, turbulent cities, or unique primeval forests.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the extreme north-east of Norway known as the Finnmark region, winters are freezing cold and snowy. Due to the location on the Arctic Ocean, the roads are prone to snow drifts. Every metre is a challenge and a journey into risk. An adventure for all those who set off into the fascinating and unique landscape, through a seemingly endless desert of snow.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Soomaa National Park is one of Europes wettest wilderness areas. Floods, forests and wetlands create a landscape where canoes replace roads during the fifth season.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Gauja National Park in Latvia features diverse wildlife, red sandstone cliffs and a winding river that flows through forests shaped by long human history.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.desc: Secluded for many centuries in inaccessible valleys, the inhabitants of the Alps had no alternative but to rely on the healing powers of nature. A knowledge of herbs was deeply rooted in these mountain-dwellers’ everyday lives – until the twentieth century, when this wisdom became eclipsed by modern academic medicine. Today, Alpine herbs are witnessing a revival, as public interest in regional natural treasures grows. The potential of Alpine herbs is far from exhausted. In the Berchtesgaden Alps, the film shows Hubsi Ilsanker at work as a root-digger, a back-breaking job that has scarcely changed in four hundred years. Authorized by a special historic permit to supply the oldest gentian distillery in Germany, Hubsi digs for protected gentian roots in Berchtesgaden National Park. For yellow gentian is one of the most bitter medicinal herbs in the world, well suited for schnapps and as a general tonic.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.desc: In the pristine nature and mild climate of southeastern Europe grows a unique diversity of wild plants. Far removed from major industry and polluted soils, the Balkan countries have become the largest exporter of herbs in Europe. In Bulgaria alone, more than 300,000 people work with domestic plants. The business is becoming increasingly lucrative. The film takes us to the Croatian coast. On the Adriatic island of Cres, the audience meets Mladen Dragoslavić. In May, when the sage begins to blossom, this beekeeper has one month to produce his income for an entire year – always with the goal of creating the best sage honey in the Balkans. Given a choice, the bees would never choose sage, for entering and exiting the narrow blossom is strenuous. Within three weeks, maximum, Mladen must remove his bees from the island. Otherwise they will die of exhaustion. In Skopje, the capital of Macedonia, the film visits Iva Yosifova. Hollyhock provides the raw material for her objects of art. The herb is medically beneficial, due to its mucilage, which is added to many cough tea mixtures. Iva, though, makes paper from hollyhock. Thanks to the herb’s long fibres, the paper can be spread onto objects and modeled. The technique produces delicate sculptures, as fragile as nature.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Europe's Wild River - The Elbe - 1.000 Miles of Wildlife and Nature
programme.desc: The river rises in the Czech Giant Mountains. Here it is called the Labe. After Děčín it flows into Germany and is called Elbe. There are various explanations for the origin of the river name "Elbe". One often mentioned is the Latin name of the river "albia", which means "bright water". This would also explain why the stream is referred to with the feminine article "the Elbe", since the Latin term "albia" is also feminine. Rather poetic than linguistically probable, however, is the explanation that elves (Middle High German: alb) scurrying around the pines in the white river mists could have helped the river to get its name. Geographically, the river can be divided into different sections: The Upper Elbe is the part from the source to about Riesa in the administrative district of Dresden, which is more characterized by mountains. The Middle Elbe, on the other hand, is a lowland river. It reaches as far as the Geesthacht dam just outside Hamburg. The Lower Elbe is called the tidal part of the river. Here, the Elbe forms an estuary, a so-called estuary. At high tide, seawater enters this funnel-shaped delta at the mouth of the Elbe and mixes with the freshwater of the river. At low tide, the water then flows off to the North Sea. Finally, the continuation of the estuary funnel in the Wadden Sea is called the Outer Elbe.

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature’s best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift or drown. Those who are not victims of the river itself risk falling prey to the crocodiles. We entered this unchartered territory, the crocodile domain by heading under water. Follow these predators in and around their habitat and watch prides of lions map out their game plan. In slow-motion, we show you the final showdown between predator and prey. Will it be a successful hunt or will the hoofed animals persevere?

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: The journey leads from the Norwegian Vesterålen to Chad, the Aeolian Islands and the Polish Giant Mountains. As different as the landscapes and cultures may be, all people are united in their love for their children and their desire to give something to tomorrow's generation.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: What ideas are people on the 15th meridian east developing to shape the future and leave tomorrow's generations a home worth living in? This consequence leads us to four future designers. From the barren Namib Desert to the glacier worlds of Spitsbergen, Sicily and the Croatian Mediterranean.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Dust And Stripes
programme.desc: In a never-ending quest for grass and water, the striped herds undertake an annual epic trek across the vast lunar landscape of the Kalahari’s Makgadikgadi Pans. Most of the year, the Makgadikgadi is an inhospitable wasteland of windswept, salt-encrusted pans. For the area’s water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. programme.title: Strongman Champions League

So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando el hada de las flores aparece en el pueblo de los Pitufos, todos se enamoran de su encanto e inteligencia. Y pronto se darán cuenta de que se convertirá en una especie de mamá pitufo para todos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo recuerda las emocionantes aventuras de Soñador en el mar, con tortugas, ballenas, islas desiertas…y piratas!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El robo del oro de las hadas por parte de Gargamel casi lleva a la guerra a los Pitufos con las hadas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La producción teatral de los Pitufos "Pitufo Robin" se convierte en realidad con un actor real del legendario héroe.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Una hermosa princesa resulta transformada en una bruja y necesita los bigotes de un gato y la lágrima de un Pitufo para preparar una poción mágica. Azrael, Pitufo Gruñón y Pitufo Bromista se convierten en colaboradores involuntarios y, cuando se produce la transformación mágica, la princesa les libera y regresan felices a su hogar.

programme.title: ¿Cómo Hacer Un Arcoíris?
programme.desc: La madre naturaleza está demasiado ocupada para evocar un Arcoíris para el Festival de los Pitufos, así que Papá Pitufo pide prestado su libro de cocina para realizar la mezcla él mismo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo y Bebé Pitufo mezclan las fórmulas de Papá Pitufo con consecuencias desastrosas, dejándoles a merced de un ejército de hambrientas langostas que Gargamel ha soltado en el bosque.

programme.title: Pitufos Leñadores
programme.desc: Un grupo de codiciosos leñadores planea talar el bosque del rey Gerard mientras se encuentra de vacaciones lejos de allí. Papá Pitufo disfraza a los Pitufos de fantasmas para espantar a los leñadores, que se rinden voluntariamente ante el rey cuando este regresa con su séquito.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel desea tener una choza más grande, y recurre al Gran libro de hechizos para conjurar un nuevo hogar. Sin embargo, todos sus hechizos le salen del revés y esto le convence de que no hay ningún sitio como el hogar.

programme.title: Dilo Por Ti Mismo, Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador esconde su amor por Pitufina ocultándose en el anonimato y enviándole poemas. Cuando finalmente se encuentran, Gigantón les captura y, en sus esfuerzos por escapar, descubren su afecto mutuo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel infecta de odio el corazón de Pitufo Fortachón y, a continuación, usa al pequeño Pitufo como señuelo para los demás. Afortunadamente, el amor de Pitufo Fortachón vence al odio y ayuda a sus pequeños amigos a escapar de las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Hay Que Atrapar Al Ladrón
programme.desc: Los Pitufos y Ómnibus se hacen amigos de un desdichado joven cuyo maestro le obliga a robar. Pronto, el malvado ladrón es entregado al magistrado y el joven está encantado de irse a vivir con Ómnibus.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Enfermizo se convierte en un héroe cuando se olvida de sus dolencias y salva al resto de los Pitufos de las peligrosas flores del olvido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos están tan ocupados demostrando su propia fuerza de voluntad que no se dan cuenta de que Gargamel ha capturado a Pitufo Armonía. Papá Pitufo ofrece a Gargamel una caja con trampa para poner a prueba su fuerza de voluntad, lo que permite escapar a Pitufo Armonía.

programme.title: Que Suerte Tan Torpe
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren la superstición cuando Pitufo Torpe rompe el espejo de Pitufo Vanidoso antes de una lluvia de meteoritos. Un meteorito cae sobre la casa de Pitufo Torpe y todos lo atribuyen a la mala suerte. Sin embargo, se dan cuenta de lo descabellado de ese pensamiento cuando comprueban que Pitufo Torpe no estaba dentro de casa en ese momento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El hada buena Guinilda entrega a Pitufo Goloso una olla mágica, pero Pitufo Filósofo hace que se desborde e inunde la aldea y el bosque. La bienintencionada hada acude al rescate y pide que le devuelvan la olla para dársela a un orfanato de niños hambrientos.

programme.title: El Mejor Amigo De Vanidoso
programme.desc: Para Pitufo Vanidoso, no hay ningún espectáculo más fabuloso ni nada más satisfactorio que contemplarse a sí mismo. Cuando se topa con un diablillo adulador, está seguro de que ha encontrado a su mejor amigo para toda la vida. Pero las cosas no siempre son tan sencillas, ya que los amigos pueden meterte en problemas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos los días la misma rutina, las mismas tareas, la misma vida… Pitufina está aburrida de todo eso. ¿No sería mucho más divertida una travesía en barco por alta mar? Y resulta que Pitufo Soñador está planeando un crucero. ¿Acaso no suena como el mismísimo paraíso?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Robotín se sobrecalienta tras el impacto de un rayo. Papá Pitufo tiene que apresurarse para enfriarlo antes de que se queme. Aun así, Pitufo Robotín utiliza su último voltio de energía para salvar a los Pitufos de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Gorjeos De Smoogle
programme.desc: Clorhidris planea transformar la primavera en la estación más infeliz del año. Atrapa el Azulejo de la Felicidad y lo transforma en un estruendoso cuervo. Cualquiera que oiga el canto del Cuervo de la Infelicidad se volverá infeliz. Solo Gruñón puede salvar la primavera.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las pinturas del malvado Maestro son capaces de tele portar a sus modelos dentro del cuadro…para siempre! Papá pitufo le dice a Pintor que cambie las pinturas y en poco tiempo Maestro acaba dentro de uno de sus cuadros, al lado de su modelo de ensueño: Pitufina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogatha se disfraza de premio de oro para observar a los Pitufos y capturarlos para sus ingredientes de belleza. Vanidoso acaba convenciéndola de que pruebe su receta y acaba cubierta de barro de vuelta a casa de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo organiza un grupo para navegar a una lejana isla ya que Gargamel ha cortado todos los árboles menos uno para atrapar a los pitufos. Gargamel les sigue pero la Bruja de la isla acaba enviando sus gaviotas tras él.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aprenden que la mente es más fuerte que la materia gracias a un engañoso y caro tónico milagroso de un charlatán. Pero Papá Pitufo les hará ver que no es más que un charlatán.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Durante una misión para interrumpir la fiesta de Halloween de los Pitufos, Gargamel y Hogatha consiguen capturar a Perezoso, el cual se ha vuelto rojo por un extraño capricho de la naturaleza. Papá Pitufo y los demás conseguirán liberar a Perezoso, y la Madre Naturaleza devolverá su color al pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado primo del Rey, Malcolm, lo ha convertido en un ciervo negro para poder acabar con él y ponerle en su sala de trofeos. Los Pitufos irán a ayudar a su amigo y, tras devolver al Rey a su verdadera forma, Malcom acabará preso dentro del cuerpo del ciervo negro.

programme.title: De Lo Que Están Hecho Los Sueños
programme.desc: Gargamel ha ideado un nuevo plan que le permitirá aniquilar a los Pitufos: ahora va a introducirse en sus sueños. Por suerte, Papá Pitufo ha oído hablar de la mágica Corona de los Sueños…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El pobre Pitufo Perezoso ya no puede dormir. Cree que está viviendo sus últimos momentos, y se dispone a hacer todas las cosas emocionantes que siempre estuvo demasiado cansado para hacer…

programme.title: La Fórmula Aniquiladora
programme.desc: Existe una palabra mágica aterradora. Cuando pronuncias esa palabra hacia algo o alguien, ¡haces que se desvanezca en la nada! ¿Podrán los Pitufos anular su malvado poder antes de que Gargamel se apropie de ella?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué contiene la curiosa caja que los Pitufos encontraron en la orilla del río? Si lo supieran, los Pitufos ni siquiera pensarían en abrirla. De esa forma, evitarían caer en las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Sonámbulos
programme.desc: Esta vez, Gargamel está seguro de que ha encontrado la solución definitiva al fastidioso asunto de los Pitufos. Su flauta mágica convertirá sus tranquilos sueños en pesadillas…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada mañana, los duendecillos del agua depositan rocío sobre las hojas del bosque. No imaginas todo lo que ocurrirá cuando Pitufo Miedoso se transforme con la varita mágica que crea las gotas de rocío…

programme.title: La Absopitufiasombrosa Máquina
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa una máquina que hará que los Pitufos controlen el clima a su voluntad.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos hambrientos descubren una cueva en donde se encuentra oculta comida congelada custodiada por un trol también congelado quien fue encarcelado debido a su avaricia por un diamante mágico. Mientras los Pitufos descongelan la cueva Gargamel roba la comida, pero el diamante mágico lo transforma en una masa helada y el trol liberado ayuda gustosamente a los Pitufos a cargar la comida de regreso a su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Y El Árbol Del Dinero
programme.desc: El mago malvado Gargamel ha elaborado otro plan diabólico con la ayuda de su madre, quien no es más agradable que él. Él quiere persuadir a los Pitufos con dinero pero ellos no saben lo que les espera. ¿Pitufo Goloso caerá en la trampa?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Día de los Inocentes Pitufo resulta no ser tan divertido cuando Gargamel se pone un disfraz de Pitufoarbusto para capturar al pequeño Pitufo Feliz. Papá Pitufo pide ayuda a Pitufopluma para que llame a los pájaros y ataquen al falso arbusto.

programme.title: La Varita Mágica
programme.desc: Con una receta que le prestó Ómnibus, Papá Pitufo crea una varita mágica que Pitufo Torpe se lleva y pierde en el bosque. Poco después, reciben la visita de Gigantón y, antes de que pueda comerse todas las pitufrutas, Papá Pitufo encuentra la varita mágica y lo aleja.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los Pitufos se preparan para el Festival de las Estrellas, Gargamel consigue infiltrar entre ellos una criatura que emite un olor a podrido tan intenso que le permitirá encontrar fácilmente la Aldea Pitufa. Papá Pitufo se da cuenta de que la criatura maloliente es de otro planeta, y manda a Plumífero que la devuelva a su hogar antes de que Gargamel les encuentre.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Otra estupenda producción del teatro de los Pitufos basada en los personajes de Alejandro Dumas. Incluye algunas líneas de Romeo y Julieta. Una obra maestra de la escena.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos van al rescate de dos niños y su abuelo, cuando un misterioso extranjero aparece haciendo que su trineo se rompa en pedazos. Al llamar a la puerta de Gargamel en busca de ayuda, no se dan cuenta de que están poniendo en peligro sus vidas y la de los Pitufos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín para que ayude a todos los Pitufos en sus labores, pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren una Fuente de la Juventud cuidada por un espantoso Troll que roba el libro mágico de Papá Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Una noche de Luna Azulada, tal y como la leyenda decía, un bebé pitufo aparece en el pueblo, y todos acaban cogiéndole cariño. Pero todo ha sido un malentendido y la cigüeña vuelve a por el bebé. Pintor y Gruñón se han encariñado tanto con el bebé que la acaban devolviéndoles el bebé.

programme.title: Lenguaje De Señas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos conocen a un elfo del bosque, que les enseña la lengua de signos después de que Gargamel les administre una poción de enmudecimiento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Creyendo que Bebé Pitufo es un duende, dos cazadores furtivos lo secuestran e intentan que el pequeño les diga dónde ha escondido la olla de oro. Papá Pitufo organiza a todos para atacar a los villanos con tartas de pitufrutas y lograr que Bebé Pitufo pueda escapar.

programme.title: Una Brujita No Tan Mala
programme.desc: Mientras hacen un recado para Papá Pitufo en el conservatorio de las brujas, las pequeñas criaturas azules conocen a una diminuta bruja y le enseñan cómo ser buena; al mismo tiempo, hacen que otra bruja pierda sus poderes maléficos durante un año al caer en el río.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En el lejano Valle de Nodrog, los Pitufos se encuentran con El Molians, que quiere conseguir la Pitufo-Piedra que Papá Pitufo necesita para curar.

programme.title: Las Nuevas Colinas Pitufas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren que no hay ningún sitio como el hogar cuando Gargamel consigue que su libro de hechizos conjure un nuevo lugar más hermoso para que los Pitufos vivan en él: ¡un lugar perfecto para que pueda tenderles una trampa!

programme.title: Campanas De Boda Para Gargamel
programme.desc: Los Pitufos se hacen amigos de una dama en apuros que está prometida a Gargamel, ya que convencen a su padre de que el estúpido mago está loco.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos ayudan a una reina de las hadas a vencer al malvado Falan, que intenta robar el sonajero mágico de su hijo.

programme.title: A Todas Las Criaturas Grandes Y Pequeñas
programme.desc: Pitufo Natural está convencido de que puede ayudar a todas las criaturas con sus dones curativos, incluso al malvado Azrael, cuya pata queda atrapada en una trampa. El gato se cura y, a pesar de que tiene la tentación de quedarse con los Pitufos, regresa con Gargamel, pero conduce a su dueño hacia un lugar alejado de la Aldea Pitufa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador anhela convertirse en rey después de leer una historia sobre reyes. Mientras está en su barco, cae a través de un remolino y llega a una tierra de pequeños seres que creen que Pitufo Soñador es su rey, desaparecido hace mucho tiempo. Cuando se enfrenta a los Norfnangs, los enemigos de esos pequeños seres, descubre que no son terroríficos en absoluto. Pitufo Soñador se da un golpe en la cabeza y descubre al despertar que todo había sido un sueño, aunque encuentra en su gorro una joya idéntica a las que extraían esos pequeños seres de su mina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel quiere crear un monstruo. Una criatura horrible y gigantesca, ¡un ser imponente que destruya a todos los Pitufos! Pero Gargamel comete un pequeño error y el resultado les dejará asombrados a su gato Azrael y a él.

programme.title: El Castillo De Las Disputas
programme.desc: En el Castillo de las Disputas casi nunca se escuchan palabras amables. El brujo Selwyn y su pareja, la bruja Tallulah, se pasan el tiempo discutiendo. Tharp, la gárgola que tienen como mascota, se refugia en la Aldea Pitufa. Pero algo terrible va a suceder…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: A veces ocurren accidentes. ¡En esta ocasión, un error de Pitufo Bromista hace que su sombra cobre vida! Y a la sombra le encanta hacer bromas a todos los habitantes de la Aldea Pitufa…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El último invento de Pitufo Carpintero, la cámara de fotos pitufomática, parece el tipo de objeto capaz de reemplazar el pausado arte de Pitufo Pintor. Sin embargo, las fotos aéreas de la Aldea Pitufa tomadas por Pitufo Carpintero caen en manos de Gargamel. La única esperanza de los Pitufos es lograr confundirlo.

programme.title: Así Es La Vida
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos gritan a Pitufo Carpintero cuando sus inventos se estropean, por lo que decide abandonar la aldea. Pero, cuando Gargamel usa las máquinas abandonadas por Pitufo Carpintero para atrapar Pitufos, Pitufo Carpintero se da cuenta de que no puede abandonar a sus amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo se convierte por accidente en rey de los Trokels. Cuando Pitufo Filósofo comienza a dar órdenes en lugar de hacer lo que los Trokels quieren, deciden destronarle… lo que para ellos significa arrojarle por un precipicio. Pitufo Filósofo aprende que ser un líder significa mucho más que dar órdenes.

programme.title: El Cachorro De Papi
programme.desc: Un golpe en la cabeza hace que Puppy pierda la memoria. Gargamel lo encuentra y decide entrenarlo para cazar Pitufos. Juntos, logran atrapar a los Pitufitos. Pero Gargamel da otro golpe a Puppy en la cabeza y este recuerda quiénes son sus verdaderos amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren el espíritu deportivo, la alegría y la amista cuando llevan a cabo sus primeros "Juegos Pitufos". Los Pitufos deciden ponerse en forma tras casi perder contra el gato Azrael.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Patoso y sus desventuras le llevan a través de un río a un lugar desconocido. Allí conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas cuyos enemigos acabarán encontrándose con los Pitufos.

programme.title: De Lo Que Están Hecho Los Sueños
programme.desc: Gargamel ha ideado un nuevo plan que le permitirá aniquilar a los Pitufos: ahora va a introducirse en sus sueños. Por suerte, Papá Pitufo ha oído hablar de la mágica Corona de los Sueños…
